statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry with vendorProject BeyondTrust and a dateAdded between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-30, following the Remote Support zero-day disclosed on 2026-10-16.
resolution: The KEV JSON feed at cisa.gov contains an entry whose vendorProject field is BeyondTrust and whose dateAdded is between 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-30 inclusive. Any BeyondTrust product qualifies.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject BeyondTrust carries a dateAdded in the 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-30 window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
